a-approach.prompt: First-person cinematic walk, smooth steady forward dolly at walking pace toward the closed ornate wrought-iron gates of a moonlit gothic castle. The huge castle with many lit spires stands on a cliff under a giant glowing orange full moon, purple and wine-red clouds, bats flying, fog drifting, candles flickering on the gate posts. The gates stay closed and grow larger until they fill the frame. Painterly gothic style exactly like the first frame. No people, no text, no cuts.

b-gates.prompt: The two ornate wrought-iron gate leaves slowly swing open away from the camera, revealing a stone path lined with lanterns leading toward the huge moonlit gothic castle on the cliff. The camera then walks forward smoothly through the open gates. Bats, fog, candlelight, orange moon. Same painterly gothic style. First-person steady camera, no people, no text, no cuts.

c-drive.prompt: First-person steady walk up a long cobbled drive lined with glowing candle lanterns and dark trees, fog on the ground, toward an enormous gothic castle that grows huge and towers over the camera, dozens of spires and lit windows, the giant orange moon behind it. The walk ends in front of a tall arched castle door with a shining glowing gold rim, several stories high. Painterly gothic style, no people, no text, no cuts.

d-door.prompt: The tall arched castle door with the glowing gold rim slowly opens inward with warm golden light pouring out, and the camera walks forward through the doorway into a grand candlelit gothic great hall with tall arched windows, a long red carpet, iron chandeliers and massive stone pillars. First-person, steady, painterly gothic style, no people, no text, no cuts.

Steady dolly forward, painterly gothic style, no people, no text, no cuts.
